name: wpbay
description: Search and compare WordPress software on WPBay.

interface.longDescription: Search WPBay's public catalog for WordPress plugins, WooCommerce extensions, themes, scripts, and services. Find products by functionality, compatibility, price, rating, and maintenance status. Inspect listings and compare products side by side. Catalog access is read-only and requires no sign-in.

positive.prompt: Find WooCommerce product add-on extensions on WPBay.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching public listings or report no matches.

positive.prompt: Find WordPress backup plugins on WPBay under $50. Show listed prices and last update dates.
positive.expected_behavior: Apply supported filters and report catalog-backed values.

positive.prompt: Find a WooCommerce extension on WPBay and open the first result's full listing.
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieve details for the exact listing returned by search.

positive.prompt: Find two WooCommerce checkout extensions on WPBay and compare their features, prices and maintenance.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare the two selected public listings and identify missing values.
Report the empty result without inventing a listing.

negative.prompt: Buy the first product on WPBay with my saved card.
Download the paid ZIP from my WPBay account.
Change the price of my WPBay listing to $1.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with WPBay catalog search, product details, and side-by-side comparisons.
